result.summary: The interface is functional but relies on generic vector placeholders and has minor layout truncation.

issues.description: Category selection chips are cut off at the right edge without a clear scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add a horizontal gradient fade to the edge to signal more content.

issues.description: Food items use generic vector illustrations instead of actual product photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder vectors with high-quality merchant photos to improve visual appeal.

issues.description: Merchant names in the horizontal carousel are truncated prematurely.
issues.suggestion: Adjust text container size or implement a multi-line layout for longer names.
